If Allah aids you no one can overcome you, and if He forsakes you no one can aid you, so believers should rely on Allah.
After injury, believers answered Allah and the Messenger at Hamra' al-Asad; warned that people had gathered against them, they said Allah is sufficient, and Satan only frightens with his supporters.
Remember Allah's favor when a people meant to attack the believers and He held back their hands, so fear Allah and rely on Him.
The hypocrites are distressed when good befalls the Prophet and rejoice at his misfortune; believers say only what Allah has decreed will strike them, and they rely on Him.
Disbelievers are told to work by their position and wait; to Allah belong the unseen of the heavens and earth and every matter, so worship Him and rely upon Him.
Rely on the Ever-Living who does not die and exalt Him with praise; He created the heavens and earth in six days and established Himself above the Throne.
Allah suffices His Servant, though threatened with other gods that cannot remove harm or withhold mercy; relying on Him, the Prophet tells his people they will know who is disgraced.
Any disagreement is referred to Allah for judgement; the Prophet declares that Allah is his Lord, on whom he relies and to whom he turns back.
No disaster strikes except by Allah's permission and He guides the believer's heart, so obey Allah and the Messenger and rely on Allah, besides whom there is no deity.
The Prophet asks who would protect disbelievers from punishment whatever Allah does with him, and declares that he believes in and relies on the Most Merciful.
